name: Gearspecies Pattern
description: to represent types of fishing gear with respect to the aquatic species they either are targeted to catch or can accidentally catch
scenarios: give me the gears targeting species "tuna" give me the species caught using "bottom gillnets" give me the gears which incidentally catch species "dolphins"
competency_questions: what type of fishing gear can catch what aquatic species?
